rubric.evidence: Lede paraphrases the chromestatus API summary. The Value grammar in the property table is quoted from the actual w3c/svgwg#1073 patch (Value: none | <number [0,∞]>; 'A <number> value must be zero or greater'), fetched 2026-07-26 via patch-diff. Note recorded on-page: MDN's formal-syntax block currently shows <length [0,∞]>, which conflicts with the spec change's unitless <number> — the spec patch is cited as authoritative. Compat rows from the feature detail: Firefox no signal (#1363), Safari closed without a position (#621).

Feature id 4861677550043136 appears in features_by_type for milestone=150 under 'Enabled by default' (listing fetched 2026-07-26). Slug from the LISTING name via the server slugify; H1 is the listing name including its trailing period.

Merged page (revision 2, after PR #2 review): the MDN card stays up top (MDN's path-length page is real coverage), and the full reference content from the former v149 route — property-definition table, live inline SVG example (path-length: 1 draw animation), three recipes, interim compat table, specifications — is retained at the corrected v150 route so the move migration does not downgrade what the old URL's followers had (durable contract: never remove established behavior to make room). Revision 3 (Codex round 4): reclassified from stub to built — the page retains a full local reference, so it now carries its own reference-contract.json and the MDN card is phrased as a companion pointer rather than a redirect.
Lede gives enough to know what shipped without leaving the page; the none-vs-0 distinction and CSS-overrides-attribute precedence are called out because they are the two subtle behaviors.

Self-contained live example: an inline SVG circle animated with path-length: 1 + stroke-dasharray 0.7 0.3, rendering in the page itself (verified in the desktop screenshot — the dashed circle draws), with a graceful fallback note for browsers without the property. Three worked recipes (draw-on animation, @property-driven animation of path-length itself, stylesheet override). Showcase feature route linked in see-also (HEAD 200).

MDN's own Browser compatibility section is the canonical table and is linked; the stub records the ChromeStatus view (Chrome 150 default; Firefox no signal; Safari closed without a position) with the standards-position links. No webstatus.dev entry as of 2026-07-26.
